name: vscode-vscode-ott
description: Language support for the Ott specification language

ott.project.profile.markdownDescription: Which `Ott.toml` profile to resolve symbols against. Empty uses the default `[spec] files` list. A file that the active profile does not include falls back to the union of every source set that does contain it, so it is never left without cross-file symbols.

ott.project.features.markdownDescription: Feature names from `Ott.toml` to append to the resolved source list, as `ott build --features` would.

enumDescriptions: Leave the dashed line of an inference rule exactly as written.
Fit the dashed line to the rule's widest line — the longer of the premises and the conclusion, never the shorter.
ott.format.rules.bar.markdownDescription: Whether `Format Document` resizes the dashed line of an inference rule. Ott never reads the bar's length, so this is purely cosmetic — but most existing specs were laid out by hand, so it is off by default.

enumDescriptions: Leave the indentation of inference rules alone.
Flush every line of a rule to the block's own left margin.
Centre the premises and conclusion over the bar.
Centre a rule with at most one premise; flush left once premises are stacked.
ott.format.rules.alignment.markdownDescription: How `Format Document` indents the lines of an inference rule. `auto` follows the usual typesetting convention: centred for a single premise, left-flush for stacked ones.

ott.format.rules.barPadding.markdownDescription: Extra dashes beyond the rule's widest line, when `#ott.format.rules.bar#` is `fit`.

ott.format.rules.maxBarWidth.markdownDescription: Upper bound on a fitted bar, or `0` for none. A handful of real rules run past 150 columns, where an exactly-fitted bar stops helping.

ott.docs.baseUrl.markdownDescription: Base URL for the “learn more” links in keyword hovers, joined onto a path under Ott's `docs/` tree. Point it at a published documentation site when one exists; set it to an empty string to drop the links.

scripts.build:prepare: shx mkdir -p ./syntaxes/ && shx cp -f ../language/syntaxes/ott.tmLanguage.json ./syntaxes/ott.tmLanguage.json && shx cp -f ../../assets/icon.png ./icon.png && shx mkdir -p ./icons/ && shx cp -f ../../assets/file-icons/ott-rule-light.svg ../../assets/file-icons/ott-rule-dark.svg ./icons/ && shx cp -f ../../LICENSE ./LICENSE
scripts.build: pnpm run build:prepare && tsc -b tsconfig.json && node esbuild.mjs
scripts.build:clean: pnpm run clean && pnpm run build
scripts.watch: pnpm run build:prepare && concurrently -n tsc,esbuild -c blue,yellow "tsc -b tsconfig.json --watch" "node esbuild.mjs --watch"
